placements.title: Async job contracts govern decoupled dispatch, receipts, and retrieval

placements.title: Receipt-based dispatch eliminates blocking calls and protects completed work from client drops
placements.frame: How does the remember contract ensure execution remains non-blocking and resilient to client disconnects?
placements.why: Wynn and Xena ratify the async remember contract where dispatch yields an immediate receipt and results are retrieved via polling or piggybacking, eliminating blocking calls and preventing lost work.
